meta.title: Download
meta.description: Download Persist for macOS, Windows or Linux. The first public builds ship soon; create an account to hear about it.

title: Download Persist
body: There is no public build yet: we are finishing signing and notarisation. Pick your system and get a heads-up when it ships.

mac.name: macOS
mac.note: Where Persist is used every day. Tested on Apple Silicon; Intel should work.

windows.name: Windows
windows.note: Ships as a preview: the build exists but has not been tested on real machines yet.

linux.name: Linux
linux.note: Ships as a preview, on the same terms as Windows.

items.title: Nothing but the app
items.body: The supervisor that keeps sessions alive ships inside Persist. No tmux or other dependency to install.

items.title: Claude Code, if you use agents
items.body: For agent sessions with states, resume and several accounts. Plain terminals work without it.

items.title: Git, for the git features
items.body: Changes, branches, restore points and a folder per session use the git on your machine.

account.title: Want a heads-up?
account.body: Create an account with your e-mail. You get a code to sign in, and we let you know when the build for your system ships.
